WITH scan_site_join AS (
  SELECT 
    s.scancount,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    si.healtheval,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
      THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
    END AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) AS total_scancount,
    AVG(gb_per_min) AS rate
  FROM scan_site_join
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
rate_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM status_stats
  WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    s.total_scancount,
    s.rate,
    s.rate - r.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg
  FROM status_stats s
  CROSS JOIN rate_average r
  WHERE r.avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND s.rate IS NOT NULL
    AND s.rate > r.avg_rate
)
SELECT * FROM filtered_statuses
ORDER BY healtheval;
